Hands-Off • Prevention & De-Escalation

DACI Level 1

Prevention, Assessment & De-Escalation

Recognize early warning signs, assess changing situations, and use calm, respectful communication to prevent and de-escalate a crisis. A hands-off foundation for safer teams.

Learning focus

  • Recognize behavioral triggers and early warning signs.
  • Use verbal and nonverbal communication to reduce tension.
  • Apply trauma-informed approaches while preserving dignity.
  • Coordinate a hands-off response and support post-incident learning.
Program 01

Designed for

Healthcare, education, behavioral health, human services, corporate, and community teams.

A hands-off program focused on prevention, assessment, communication, and recovery.

8-hour comprehensive program

Onsite Instructor-Led OnlyView Curriculum & Program Details
Intermediate Physical Skills • Designated Response Roles

DACI Level 2

Prevention, Assessment & De-Escalation with Intermediate Physical Skills

Prepare healthcare and behavioral health teams to recognize, assess, and de-escalate crises, coordinate a team response, and practice intermediate safety skills under instructor supervision.

Learning focus

  • Recognize psychiatric and behavioral warning signs.
  • Assess changing risks and use therapeutic communication.
  • Coordinate a team response within organizational policy.
  • Support safety, documentation, and recovery after an incident.
Program 02

Designed for

Healthcare and behavioral health professionals, direct-care teams, and designated clinical response staff.

Physical skills are matched to staff responsibilities, organizational policy, and instructor assessment.

8-hour or 16-hour certification

Law Enforcement & Corrections Only

DACI Level 3

Advanced Crisis Intervention, Subject Control & Restraint

Advanced crisis communication, assessment, and instructor-supervised subject control and restraint training for law enforcement and corrections personnel.

Learning focus

  • Recognize escalation and assess changing threats.
  • Apply de-escalation and agency-approved decision-making principles.
  • Coordinate a response within agency policy and authorized duties.
  • Recognize medical distress and complete post-incident responsibilities.
Program 03

Designed for

Law enforcement officers and corrections or detention personnel only.

Restricted to law enforcement and corrections. This program is not offered as a general healthcare, school, retail, or private-security pathway.

24-hour basic certification

Youth & Adolescent Support • Hands-Off

DACI Youth

Adolescent Crisis Prevention, Assessment, De-Escalation & Therapeutic Support

Help youth-serving teams notice concerns early, listen without judgment, and offer clear choices. Rehearse hands-off responses for difficult moments with young people.

Learning focus

  • Notice changes that may signal a young person needs help.
  • Check immediate safety needs before choosing a response.
  • Offer clear choices and respectful limits.
  • Seek help from colleagues when needed.
  • Plan a respectful check-in after a difficult interaction.
Program 04

Designed for

Educators, behavioral health professionals, residential treatment staff, juvenile care providers, and other youth-serving teams.

Developmentally appropriate, trauma-informed support without physical intervention techniques.

8-hour planning estimate

Onsite Instructor-Led OnlyView Curriculum & Program Details
Dementia & Cognitive Support • Hands-Off

DACI Memory

Dementia Education, De-Escalation & Crisis Intervention

Help care teams respond thoughtfully when a person living with dementia becomes upset or confused. Plan calm conversations, familiar routines, and hands-off support around the individual.

Learning focus

  • Notice changes in daily routines that may need attention.
  • Ask about familiar habits and preferences when planning care.
  • Consider discomfort, confusion, or the surroundings when distress occurs.
  • Adjust the pace and wording of care.
  • Pause tasks and ask for help when needed.
  • Share useful observations with the next member of the care team.
Program 05

Designed for

Memory care, assisted living, skilled nursing, home care, hospice, adult day services, and healthcare teams supporting people living with dementia.

Person-centered, non-physical support for individuals living with dementia and cognitive impairment.

8-hour planning estimate

Onsite Instructor-Led OnlyView Curriculum & Program Details
Customer-Facing Teams • Hands-Off

DACI Retail

Retail Crisis Prevention & De-Escalation

Help customer-facing teams recognize rising frustration, communicate respectfully, maintain professional boundaries, and involve the right support before a situation escalates.

Learning focus

  • Recognize signs of customer frustration and escalating tension.
  • Use respectful communication and clear boundaries.
  • Choose hands-off responses and seek designated support.
  • Document concerns and identify opportunities for prevention.
Program 06

Designed for

Retail sales associates, customer service staff, store managers, and other customer-facing teams.

A hands-off pathway tailored to the organization’s customer service and safety policies.

4-hour planning estimate
